question: For each instance display name, show the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (MEMORY_MB) across instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Only include display names that appear in more than 1 such instance, and only return display names whose memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than the overall average of these per-display-name standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)s. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH per_group AS (
  SELECT 
    i.display_name AS display_name,
    STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS mem_stddev,
    COUNT(*) AS instance_count
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  GROUP BY i.display_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
  pg.display_name,
  pg.mem_stddev
FROM per_group pg
WHERE pg.mem_stddev > (SELECT AVG(mem_stddev) FROM per_group)
